$comment: Copy to signal.config.json (git-ignored). Every switch is off until you set it to true. SIGNAL_FEATURE_<NAME>=1 in the environment overrides a switch. The kill switches SIGNAL_PUBLISH_PAUSED=1 and SIGNAL_AUTOPILOT_PAUSED=1 always win. "contentGenerators" is optional: without it every package generator may be approved; with it, only the listed ones. "postmaker.dayCapUsd" is an optional day cap in USD per Post maker connector. SIGNAL_POSTMAKER_PAUSED=1 stops every Post maker service call.
